improvement.supernatural_perception.desc: Perceives what escapes the ordinary gaze — presences, echoes, phenomena invisible to most.
improvement.flashlight.description: A flashlight, to light up what the dark hides.
improvement.mirror_pass.description: The right to step through certain mirrors as one steps through a door.
improvement.master_key.description: A key that opens the ordinary doors of the town, the ones locked out of habit rather than distrust.
improvement.skeleton_key.description: A key that opens what the master key leaves shut: the locks meant to be truly inviolable.
